verdict.rationale: Angular's official site explicitly offers 'completely in browser tutorial lessons designed to give you hands on experience with Angular' (angular-docs-5). The installation page confirms you can play around in the browser without setting up a project (angular-docs-8). Together these cover the hands-on, no-local-setup story directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the tutorial, and detail on the scope and interactivity of the lessons beyond brief first-party claims.
